outcome_evidence: The oven door is open at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot progressively approaches the door area through frames 35–135; wrist_image shows the door edge close to the gripper at frames 136–165. At frame 165, image and left_ego_image still show the door projecting outward rather than closed against the oven. Completion is therefore unconfirmed in the observed episode; the images show an unfinished closing attempt, not a clearly completed failed acquisition, loss of control, or other distinct local failure.
